title: Emerald Cave Kayak Tour Near Las Vegas at Willow Beach
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Book your guided Emerald Cave kayak tour and experience an unforgettable outdoor adventure near Las Vegas as you paddle to Emerald Cave on the majestic Colorado River.

Located just 1 hour from the Las Vegas Strip, this small-group guided tour launches from Willow Beach on the calm, clear waters of the Colorado River beneath the towering walls of the spectacular Black Canyon.

Perfect for friends, families, couples, beginners, and active travelers, your tour includes an ACA-Certified Professional Guide, premium Wilderness Systems single-person kayak, drybag, snacks and water.

Paddle at a relaxed pace, look for wildlife like bighorn sheep and bald eagles, and enjoy swim breaks along the way.

Best of all, your guide will take photos so you can enjoy the experience and take home incredible memories at no extra cost.

This half-day adventure is the perfect escape from the city into the most spectacular scenery in the Southwest
